sources.summary: Shou Sugi Ban House is a residential architecture project situated in Perth , Western Australia. This distinctive project is named after the key material used in the new addition to a beautiful character home, showcasing a unique blend of traditional and modern elements. The use of Shou Sugi Ban, a traditional Japanese technique of charring wood, adds a striking visual aesthetic to the property.
